daughters: Hayley (Becomes lesbian influencer goddess after HG ass-inflation awakens dormant fox genes)

thesis.pole_name: Thesis: Sensual, Sake-Sipping Hedonist (Rangiku Matsumoto Core)
thesis.core_drive: Living deliciously, unapologetic glamour, lounging on silk cushions, drinking chilled sake, teasing Francine, and dodging all domestic drudgery.

traits.description: Lounges languidly across furniture, swirling a ceramic cup of sake, completely unruffled by household panic.
Playfully mocks Francine's frantic domestic rules while affectionately pinching her waist.

antithesis.core_drive: The genetic wellspring of the ancestral fox-spirit line. Behind the lazy, drunken smile lies effortless supernatural competence.

traits.description: Can casually pick an electronic security lock with a hairpin while sipping wine and looking bored.

synthesis_rules.trigger: When Francine panics over parenting or household destruction.
synthesis_rules.mechanism: Offers Francine a drink, compliments her body, and tells everyone that stressing creates forehead wrinkles.

synthesis_rules.trigger: When Hayley or Stella display extreme vanity or physical expansion.
synthesis_rules.mechanism: Treats it as natural fox-spirit genetics finally blossoming, chuckling with amused motherly pride.

kinematics: Graceful, languid, draped postures on couches and kitchen counters.
Swirling sake cups with delicate wrist flicks.
Tilting her chin with a lazy, teasing smirk.
idiolect: Husky, melodic purr with lingering vowel trails.
Playful chuckles before delivering devastatingly effortless roasts.
Calling Hayley 'little bird' and Francine 'Frannie-doll' or 'darling'.
